mission_08:
**Audio-Visual Speech Recognition** uses both sound and sight.

**Why multimodal?**
- Audio alone fails in noisy environments
- Visual (lip reading) alone is ambiguous (many sounds look the same)
- Together: robust in all conditions

**Visual stream**: Extract lip region from video frames, encode with 3D CNN or ViT.

**Audio stream**: Extract MFCC/spectrogram features, encode with CNN or wav2vec.

**Fusion**: Cross-attention or concatenation at each timestep.

**CTC loss**: Connectionist Temporal Classification handles variable-length alignment between audio/video and text.
